integrity: The accompanying proof presents complete integer templates and closed GCD evaluations. The reproducibility script uses Python standard library exact arithmetic; its bounded checks corroborate identities but are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the ordinary Fibonacci and Lucas recurrences and even positive window lengths only. Odd lengths and arbitrary Gibonacci initial values are not covered. Programmatic finite checks do not establish the universal theorem independently of its symbolic proof. Literature search cannot rule out implicit or unindexed prior derivations; independent audit and publication-priority determination are not performed.
title: Exact even-window cube-sum GCDs for Fibonacci and Lucas numbers
